svg.title: Outreach workflow from the architecture and implemented phases
svg.desc: A user goal enters through the CLI or API, becomes workflow state, and is coordinated by RunManager and LangGraph. Goal interpretation, research, prospects, qualification, memory checks, contact policy, strategy, writing, review, human approval, optional Gmail action, outcome, and memory update follow in order. Qualification and contact policy can stop outreach. Rewrites and human edits share one revision. Approval can reject, edit, pause, or proceed. Gmail can create a draft or send only when sending is explicitly enabled. Relationship history is saved for later runs. Checkpoints, tracing, security, and operating limits support execution; tests and evaluations check it separately.
